en.headline: Centre for Health Protection investigates death of nine-year-old boy from invasive…
en.dek: The previously healthy boy developed fever and cough from 10 October, was transferred to intensive care on the 14th and died the following day at Tuen Mun Hospital.
body: The Centre for Health Protection is investigating a fatal case of invasive pneumococcal disease involving a nine-year-old boy who died at Tuen Mun Hospital on 15 October.

The boy, who had previously been in good health, developed fever, runny nose, cough and chest pain from 10 October. He visited a private clinic on the 10th and 13th. On the 14th he was taken to Tin Shui Wai Hospital with shortness of breath and transferred the same day to the paediatric intensive care unit at Tuen Mun Hospital. His condition deteriorated and he died on the 15th.

Pleural fluid tested positive for Streptococcus pneumoniae. The clinical diagnosis was pneumonia complicated by empyema, septic shock and acute kidney failure. The centre is carrying out further laboratory tests, including serotyping. Preliminary inquiries show the boy had not travelled during the incubation period and household contacts have no symptoms. The case has been referred to the coroner.

zh.headline: 衞生防護中心調查九歲男童染侵入性肺炎球菌病死亡個案
zh.dek: 男童10月10日起發燒咳嗽，14日轉送屯門醫院兒童深切治療部，翌日不治。
body: 衞生防護中心正調查一宗九歲男童因侵入性肺炎球菌病死亡的個案。
男童過往健康良好，自10月10日起出現發燒、流鼻水、咳嗽及胸痛，曾兩度求診私家診所。14日因氣促被送往天水圍醫院急症室，同日轉送屯門醫院兒童深切治療部，病情轉壞後於15日死亡。
胸膜分泌液對肺炎鏈球菌呈陽性，臨床診斷為肺炎併發膿胸、敗血性休克及急性腎衰竭。中心正進行進一步化驗及血清型分析。初步調查顯示男童潛伏期無外遊，家居接觸者無病徵，案件已交死因裁判官跟進。
